user.description: Add Room Valve Control. Rooms are added to it afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Room Valve Control is already set up.

data_description.name: Name of the room and of its thermostat entity.
data_description.sensors: The room temperature is the mean of the sensors that have reported within the stale sensor timeout.
data_description.trvs: Eurotronic Spirit TRVs. Each TRV's valve control and temperature offset (parameter 8) entities must be enabled. A TRV can belong to one room only. Leave empty for a floor-heating room.
data_description.floor_heaters: Floor-heating thermostats, instead of TRVs. Each heats for the valve output's share of every control step. A floor heater can belong to one room only.
data_description.kp: Valve change in % points per °C of control error.
data_description.ti: Time in which the integral term adds as much as the proportional term at a constant error.
data_description.control_step: How often the valve position is computed; for floor heaters, the length of each on/off period.
data_description.min_change: A TRV is written only when the computed position differs from its valve reading by at least this many % points. Above {endpoint_tolerance} and at most {valve_max}.
data_description.stale_timeout: When no wall sensor has reported for this long, the TRVs regulate on their own and floor heaters hold the fallback floor setpoint.
data_description.min_target: Lowest target temperature the room thermostat accepts.
data_description.max_target: Highest target temperature the room thermostat accepts.
data_description.floor_max: Floor setpoint written to switch the floor heating on. The thermostat itself keeps the floor at or below it. Floor heaters only.
data_description.floor_min: Floor setpoint written to switch the floor heating off. The thermostat still heats a floor colder than this. Floor heaters only.
data_description.fallback_floor_setpoint: Floor setpoint the thermostats hold on their own while the room is not controlled. Between the floor minimum and maximum. Floor heaters only.
data_description.min_on_time: Shorter on- or off-times are dropped from a control step. At most half the control step. Floor heaters only.

error.no_sensor: Select at least one wall temperature sensor.
error.sensor_not_registered: {sensor} has no unique ID, so the room could not find it again after a rename. Give it a unique ID or select another sensor.
error.trvs_and_heaters: A room has TRVs or floor heaters, not both.
error.trv_entity_missing: {trv} is not usable: its {entity} entity was not found. Only Eurotronic Spirit TRVs on Z-Wave JS are supported.
error.trv_entity_disabled: {trv} is not usable: its {entity} entity {entity_id} is disabled. Enable it and try again.
error.trv_no_device: {trv} is not usable: it belongs to no device. Only Eurotronic Spirit TRVs on Z-Wave JS are supported.
error.min_change_out_of_range: Must be above {endpoint_tolerance} and at most {valve_max} % points.
error.target_range_empty: Must be greater than the minimum target temperature.
error.heater_not_registered: {heater} has no unique ID, so the room could not find it again after a rename. Give it a unique ID or select another thermostat.
error.heater_entity_disabled: {heater} is disabled. Enable it and try again.
error.heater_is_room: {heater} is the thermostat of a Room Valve Control room, not a floor-heating thermostat.
error.not_whole_degrees: Must be a whole number of degrees.
error.floor_setpoints_out_of_order: The floor minimum, fallback floor setpoint and floor maximum must rise in that order.
error.min_on_time_too_long: Must be at most half the control step.

unusable_trv.title: TRV left out of {room}
unusable_trv.description: {device} is not usable: {reason}. The room is controlled without it, and the TRV is left as it is. Fix the TRV, or reconfigure the room without it; this issue clears when the integration next reloads.

unusable_floor_heater.title: Floor heater left out of {room}
unusable_floor_heater.description: {device} is not usable: {reason}. The room is controlled without it, and the floor heater is left as it is. Fix it, or reconfigure the room without it; this issue clears when the integration next reloads.

room_without_devices.title: {room} is not controlled
room_without_devices.description: None of the room's TRVs or floor heaters is usable, so the room is not set up and its entities are unavailable. Fix one, or reconfigure the room; this issue clears when the integration next reloads.
